parameters: Exactly root frozen protocol; r by bisection of cubic on[1.7,1.73], no fit; K/C/Rayleigh/kappa/c generated from definitions.
algorithm: Independent standard explicit RK4 for augmented states [u1,u2,v1,v2,F,W_input,D_background,D_device]; four actual runs: layoutsA andB each N8192 and16384 steps perT, total6N. No trajectory produced by swapping another run.
forcing: sin(t) on0<=t<T=20pi; endpointT set exactly mathematical0, then0. Stage times use step indices/half indices rather than accumulated clock; cutoff atN exactly.
stored_energy: E=0.5(v1²+v2²)+0.5*u^T K u+F²/(2kappa), E0=0; backgroundC excludes Maxwell spring; Wdot=(v1+v2)f, Db_dot=v^TCv, Dd_dot=F²/c. Integrals are augmented RK4 states, no clipping.
comparison: Sampled absolute peak at original grid points with signed value and all exact tied peak times. Report no peak interpolation/threshold. Compare B to P*A at every matching time; F and allthree integrated budgets unchanged underP. Compare each kinetic/physicalelastic/deviceelastic/total energy trajectory.
step_convergence: Compare fine every2nd point against coarse at allcommon times for all8states and totalE; report changes in sampled peaks and terminalbudgets, no posthoc pass threshold or parameter adjustment.
balance: Max over full0..6T of E-W+Db+Dd; also values atT/end and terminalstoredenergy. Normalized diagnostic divide by max(1,maxabsW,maxE), arithmetic only.
symmetry_arithmetic_tolerance: 1e-10*max(1,maxabscomparedvalues), diagnostic only, not a rigorous ODE/globalpeak error bound. Keepactualfailures.
tail_scope: Finite sampled0..6T support only; fulltail/fullpeak proof belongs to role1R013. This is syntheticalpha1, not useralpha.3, realETABS or newindicator.
outputs: Small four-run summaryCSV, convergenceCSV, protocol/script/JSON/report; no full state/time arrays written or uploaded, no graph dependencies/Excel/solver.
